title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2611.29592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. translated_title: 重新思考封闭式医学视觉语言模型评估：从稳定错误到反事实答案敏感性
translated_abstract: 随着医学视觉语言模型越来越多地被评估用于临床决策支持场景，了解何时信任其预测变得至关重要。封闭式医学视觉问答（VQA）已成为常见的基准评估格式，因为它支持自动评分。然而，针对这种格式是否会改变模型可靠性问题的系统性研究仍然稀缺。我们识别出一种称之为“稳定错误”的失败模式：即使移除或不匹配患者特定的视觉证据，模型仍能产生保持高置信度且可重复的错误是/否答案。这一失败违反了采样稳定性不确定性方法（包括最近的幻觉感知校准 HAC 变体）背后的前提假设：只有当错误本身不稳定时，模型间的分歧才具有信息价值。当由捷径驱动的错误本身是稳定的时候，采样一致性可能会保持看似很高的欺骗性水平。受此局限性的启发，我们提出了反事实答案敏感性（CAS），它将评估重心转向……
tldr: 该论文揭示了医学视觉语言模型在封闭式问答中存在的“稳定错误”失败模式——模型在缺乏相关视觉证据时仍会自信且可重复地给出错误答案，从而使基于采样一致性的不确定性评估方法失效，并提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS）作为更可靠的评估手段。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a "stable wrongness" failure mode in closed-ended medical VQA—where models confidently and repeatably produce incorrect answers even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched—which undermines sampling-stability uncertainty methods, and proposes Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS) as a more reliable evaluation approach.
